## TRA Timeline

#### Origination at IPO

- 2021-03-16: Form-of TRA first filed as Exhibit 10.17 to S-1/A
- 2021-03-24: TRA executed at IPO close between Diversey Holdings (Cayman PubCo), Diversey Holdings I (UK), BCPE Diamond Cayman Holding (Shareholder Representative), and Shareholders listed on Schedule A

#### Termination at Olympus Water / Solenis acquisition

- 2023-03-08: Tax Receivable Termination Agreement executed concurrent with Merger Agreement; provides TRA terminates irrevocably at the Effective Time of the Merger for no consideration, conditional on consummation
- 2023-07-05: Merger with Olympus Water Holdings IV (Platinum Equity / Solenis affiliate) closes; TRA terminates by operation of the Termination Agreement

## Explanation

This TRA originated at Diversey's March 2021 IPO and was structured around a Cayman PubCo and a UK holding company, with the covered tax assets being Pre-IPO U.S. Tax Assets (paid in USD) and Pre-IPO Dutch Tax Assets (paid in Euros), including foreign tax credits, NOLs, and similar items attributable to periods on or prior to the IPO. The payment percentage was 85%. At the March 2023 announcement of the Olympus Water Holdings IV / Solenis acquisition, the parties executed a freestanding Tax Receivable Termination Agreement providing that the TRA would terminate at the Merger Effective Time "for no consideration"; the unusual zero-consideration release is explained by Bain Capital's role as the controlling pre-IPO shareholder, which rolled equity into the buyer's Topco rather than cashing out, and by a separate $200M-cap Tax Indemnity Agreement that BCPE delivered to the buyer in lieu of TRA payments. The Merger closed July 5, 2023 and the TRA terminated at that Effective Time. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
